changelog:
Initial release of Competitive Intelligence Agent.

- Automates monitoring of competitors’ pricing, social media, online reviews, and product changes.
- Provides configurable alerting and concise weekly briefing reports delivered via Slack, email, Telegram, or file.
- Supports daily/weekly monitoring schedules and real-time alerts for price changes, product launches, negative reviews, and more.
- Simple setup: configure competitors, delivery channels, monitoring rules, and run full sweeps or targeted reports.
- Includes ready-to-use prompts and commands for interactive operation and team notifications.
summary: Monitors competitors across pricing, social media, online reviews, and product changes — distills everything into a concise weekly briefing.
